caseName: Spalding v. People ex rel. Backus
caseNameFull: Spalding v. The People of the State of New York, ex rel, Frederick F. Backus
headnotes: An appeal bond given to the people or to the relator is good, and if forfeited, may be sued upon by either.
attorneys: Beardsley moved to dismiss the writ of error in this • case, because Spalding had given a bond to The People of the State of New York, or Frederick F. Backus.

opinions.author: Story
opinions.text:
But Mr. Justice STORY

delivered the opinion of the court, and said that the bond was good, and, if forfeited, might be sued upon in the name of the people or of the relator, at the option of the government.
